cards.text: Last time, in Caesarea, the Holy Spirit fell on a whole houseful of Gentiles while Peter was still speaking (Acts 10:44). Now the news travels, and nobody even needed a group chat. The apostles and brothers throughout Judea hear that the Gentiles also received the word of God.

cards.question: True or false: when Peter goes up to Jerusalem, the circumcised believers welcome him with open arms.
The circumcised believers in Jerusalem have a complaint for Peter. What is it?

answers.text: He visited uncircumcised men and ate with them
He baptized people without asking the apostles
He stayed away from Jerusalem far too long

cards.text: So Peter starts at the beginning and walks them through the whole sequence of events. That's more than I ever managed the day somebody asked me why the whole kitchen was full of smoke.
Peter starts in Joppa. He was praying, and in a trance he saw a vision: something let down from heaven by its four corners, coming right down to him.

cards.question: In Peter's vision, what came down from heaven by its four corners?
Peter looked closely at the sheet from heaven. What did he see in it?

cards.text: Then Peter tells them he heard a voice: "Get up, Peter, kill and eat." Friend, if that were me, these eyebrows would've shot straight up into my hat.

cards.question: True or false: when the voice tells Peter to kill and eat, Peter jumps right up and does it.
Peter answers the voice with No Lord. What reason does he give?

answers.text: Nothing impure has ever entered his mouth
He has been fasting since early that morning
He doesn't know whose voice is speaking

cards.question: The voice speaks from heaven a second time: Do not call anything impure that God has made ___.
Peter tells them this whole back-and-forth with the voice happened ___ times.

cards.text: Then everything is drawn back up into heaven, the sheet and the animals and all of it. Gone, faster than a fresh batch off my cooling rack when a baker walks by.
Just then, three men sent from Caesarea stop at the house where Peter is staying. JUST THEN. My oven timer has never once been that on time.

cards.question: The Spirit tells Peter what to do about the three men from Caesarea. What is it?
True or false: Peter heads off with the men from Caesarea all by himself.

cards.text: Six brothers went along, and they all enter the home of Cornelius, a centurion in Caesarea (Acts 10:1). Cornelius tells them he saw an angel standing right there in his house.

cards.question: True or false: Cornelius says the angel told him to send to Joppa for Simon who is called Peter.
The angel said Peter would bring a message by which Cornelius and all his household would be ___.

cards.text: Then Peter tells them the big moment: as he began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell upon them. Friend, Peter didn't even make it to his second point.

cards.question: Peter says the Holy Spirit fell on the people in that house in a way he recognized. How?

answers.text: The same way He fell on Peter's group at first
Only after every one of them was baptized
Slowly over many long days of prayer

cards.text: Right then, Peter remembered something the Lord had said. One of those moments where it all clicks at once.

cards.question: Watching the Holy Spirit fall on that house, what word of the Lord did Peter remember?

answers.text: John baptized with water but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit
Go and make disciples of all nations and baptize them in My name
Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved on the last day

cards.text: So Peter lays it out plain. If God gave them the same gift He gave us who believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, then what?

cards.question: Then Peter asks the believers in Jerusalem: who was I to ___ the work of God?
True or false: after hearing Peter out, the believers in Jerusalem keep arguing with him.
Their objections are gone. What do the believers in Jerusalem do instead?

cards.text: And they say it out loud: "So then, God has granted even the Gentiles repentance unto life." They went from taking issue with Peter's dinner guests to glorifying God, and now THAT is a turnaround.

findings.problem: This 'which thing' question has the wrong answer 'Something like a golden basket'. A golden basket isn't a real detail from the Bible. 'Wooden ark' works, but the golden basket needs to be replaced with something real, like a real basket or another real object.

rule.text: For who, which thing and where questions, wrong answers are real details from somewhere in the Bible, like Joppa when the right answer is Tarshish.

findings.problem: This story card has three sentences: 'Just then... staying.', 'JUST THEN.' and 'My oven timer has never once been that on time.' Only the opening card may go past two sentences.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: Papa Dorin uses Peter's exact words 'the same gift He gave us who believed in the Lord Jesus Christ' with no quotation marks, so the line reads as his own narration. That puts Papa Dorin among the 'us' who received the gift, as if he were part of the event. The line should either quote Peter with quotation marks or be reworded, for example 'the same gift He gave Peter and the others who believed.'

rule.text: Never part of a Bible event. He never says he was there, saw it or knew anyone in it. His story is only the Millers' kitchen, the junk drawer and the Dorinverse.

findings.problem: 'Taking issue with Peter's dinner guests' gets Acts 11:3 backwards. The complaint is that Peter visited uncircumcised men and ate with them. He was the visitor, not the host, so they weren't his guests. The card also uses 11:2-3 for that callback but cites only Acts 11:18. The closing joke ('now THAT is a turnaround') is also mild. It reads like a nice dad being pleasant and could be pushed further.

rule.text: Retelling: Papa Dorin can retell in his own words and fill in what the text clearly implies. Scene-setting details are fine. He never says anything the text shows is wrong.

findings.problem: The wrong answers put sayings in the Lord's mouth that are altered or invented. 'Go and make disciples of all nations and baptize them in My name' changes Matthew 28:19. 'Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved on the last day' adds words to Mark 16:16. The docs say wrong answers are made up, and that Papa Dorin retells what Jesus said faithfully. They don't say whether a made-up wrong answer can be written as a saying of Jesus, or can change a real one.
findings.question: Can wrong answers present invented or altered words as sayings of the Lord (Jesus or God)? Or must wrong answers for 'what did the Lord say' questions avoid looking like real Scripture?
